final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS value FROM media_averages) SELECT media_type_name, avg_bytes_per_millisecond, avg_bytes_per_millisecond - value FROM media_averages CROSS JOIN overall_average WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND avg_bytes_per_millisecond > value
